messages:
Sophia: @emma quick heads up — NebulaBank RFP: they want a private deployment either in their AWS VPC or in their on-prem colo. Requirements: FIPS-compliant crypto, HSM for keys (Thales), no outbound internet egress, timeline ~12 weeks after PO. Target models: Llama-3 + our quantized rwd-ggml. QPS target ~50, ~200k tokens/day steady. Can we triage feasibility + dependencies?

Emma: Thanks @sophia. A few clarifying asks before we scope: 1) exact region/datacenter 2) peak concurrency vs sustained 3) what does "no egress" mean operationally (totally blocked or allowed to a few endpoints?) 4) SSO/IdP + audit log retention 5) PO/timeline certainty. Also: is this Dedicated capacity or Private (customer-managed infra)? @noah can you pick this up for pre-sales checklist?

Noah: I can run discovery. I'll get network diagram, certs, KMS SLA, preferred GPUs. Proposed next step: 30m call with Nebula infra + security. My avail: tomorrow 11:00-12:00 UTC or Wed 14:00-15:00 UTC.

Liam: From infra POV — this is doable but has clear blockers: (a) HSM integration (Thales — need vendor API/test device), (b) GPUs: validated on A100/H100 only, need node counts, (c) storage: model copies 60–200GB depending on quant, (d) kernel/driver compatibility for their OS, (e) if outbound is fully blocked we need an air-gap plan for model updates and telemetry. Quick checklist below for the discovery call: 

```
- [ ] Network: VPN / Direct Connect, private IP ranges, firewall rules + NAT expectations
- [ ] Storage: NFS vs S3 gateway, size & IOPS requirements
- [ ] GPUs: model/quant profile, node counts (A100/H100), vGPU ok?
- [ ] KMS / HSM: vendor, API endpoints, test creds, key rotation policy
- [ ] OS / Container images: base image, driver versions, kernel modules
- [ ] Telemetry: allowlist endpoints or offline logs bundle plan
- [ ] Auth: SSO (SAML / OIDC) or local accounts + RBAC expectations
- [ ] Model update strategy: customer-push vs vendor-push (signed artifacts)
- [ ] Backups & DR: artifacts, configs, time-to-restore
- [ ] SLA & support hours, escalation path
- [ ] Compliance: SOC2 / PCI-DSS / regulator-specific attestations
```

Emma: Add legal request: data flow diagram for DPIA. Also pricing will differ materially between Dedicated and Private — flag that for GTM. I'll draft high level timeline once we confirm dependencies.

Olivia: Security notes: require TLS1.3 enforced, disk encryption with keys in HSM, no plaintext logs, IDS/IPS on customer side recommended. If PCI applies — cardholder data must be isolated; we will need a signed attestation and pentest window. Also confirm retention and export capability for audit logs.

Sophia: Nebula answered: they can provide a private subnet in AWS GovCloud or a colo in LON. HSM vendor = Thales, PO expected in ~6 weeks. They asked explicitly if telemetry can be removed completely (no telemetry).

Liam: Thales we can integrate but will need their test HSM and API docs. Telemetry: we can offer an opt-out but that increases support cost and slows debugging — we'd provide an offline logs bundle and scheduled triage windows. Model updates options: customer-managed S3 (signed URLs) or vendor push via signed tarball over SCP.

Noah: I booked discovery call for Wed 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC with Nebula infra + security. Invite & agenda sent, pre-read attached.

intake-bot: Ticket RWD-4582 created for NebulaBank private deployment intake. Link: https://redwood.internal/issue/RWD-4582

Emma: :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll synthesize a backlog item and a proposed timeline: 12w estimate split -> 2w design, 6w infra/provision, 2w validation, 2w rollout. Assigning @Liam + @Noah to produce implementation plan + cost delta between Dedicated vs Private.

Olivia: Note for the record: require audit log export to customer SIEM, evidence of key custody (HSM certs), and quarterly compliance checks.

Noah: Capturing action items in RWD-4582: 1) discovery call (done) 2) request Thales test creds + API 3) produce supported GPU/driver matrix 4) confirm "no-egress" operational mode and update pattern 5) estimate infra BOM and timeline.

Sophia: ack, will prep customer answers and PO timeline.

Liam: ack. Will start draft of BOM and driver matrix after discovery call.
